sloka: सीताम् तु मोहिताम् दृष्ट्वा सरमा नाम राक्षसी ।आससाद आशु वैदेहीम् प्रियाम् प्रणयिनी सखी ।। ६-३३-१।।
transliteration: sītām tu mohitām dṛṣṭvā saramā nāma rākṣasī ।āsasāda āśu vaidehīm priyām praṇayinī sakhī ।। 6-33-1।।

translations.english: Then seeing Sita in distraught, a Rakshasi by name Saarana who was very dear and friendly with Vaidehi approached her.
